name: Cheesy BBQ Chickpea Wrap with Cabbage, Carrot & Apple Slaw

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, drain and rinse chickpeas.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chickpeas, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender and warmed through, 8-10 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 tsp extra virgin olive oil
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 medium head napa cabbage
2 medium carrots
2 Granny Smith apples

instructions.primary_message: Place yogurt, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup plain Greek yogurt
apple cider vinegar
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim off and discard root end of cabbage; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots. Add to the bowl.
Quarter, core, and coarsely grate apples. Add to the bowl, stir to combine the slaw, and set aside.
Place ketchup, vinegar, soy sauce, Dijon, and spices in another medium bowl. Whisk to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup ketchup
apple cider vinegar
1 tsp soy sauce
1 tsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp chili powder
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Coarsely grate cheese. Add to the bowl with the sauce, along with chickpeas, then stir to combine the cheesy chickpea filling.
Place tortillas on a flat surface, then divide cheesy chickpea filling and a small portion of slaw between them. Roll tightly to close. (Reserve remaining slaw for serving.)
Cut wraps in half and divide between plates. Serve with remaining slaw on the side and enjoy!
